Label: Limited time offer
Notes: Show: Yes or No. Rate: percent of market price. Min Value / Max Value: slab market value in dollars (blank = hide that line). Ends: last day of the offer, like 11/30/2026 (blank = no end date; the banner hides itself after that day). Details: optional extra line. Only the first row that is switched on and not expired is shown. To turn the banner off set Show to No or delete the row.
